scripts.build:dist: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist/myact dist/logconv dist/wspr dist/shared && cp -r apps/myact/* dist/myact/ && cp -r apps/logconv/* dist/logconv/ && cp -r apps/wspr/* dist/wspr/ && cp -r packages/shared/* dist/shared/
scripts.pages:dev: pnpm run build && wrangler pages dev dist --port 8788
scripts.pages:deploy: pnpm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist
